itemized.notes: 11-page filing. p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed upstream, not redone), p3 Schedule A form and p10 Schedule B form are BLANK grids with 'See Attached' handwritten in the first Name cell; the itemization is two LANDSCAPE computer printouts headed 'Jani Iwamoto Campaign / Donations Report (or Expense Report) / June 17 - September 10, 2008', rotated 90 deg CW to read (pdftoppm portrait render rotated -90 in PIL). Geometry percentages are converted back to the portrait render as required, so a contribution row is a narrow VERTICAL band. The Donations Report prints separate 'Last Name' and 'First Name' columns; donor_raw is 'Last, First' verbatim from those two cells (organizations occupy the Last Name cell alone). The printout HAS Address/City/State/Zip columns but every one of them is EMPTY for every row - the filer left them blank (not a county redaction) - so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. Contribution amounts are printed to whole dollars only; expenditure amounts carry cents. The Donations Report also prints Occupation and Employer columns, which the row contract has no field for; they were used only to cross-check column alignment (e.g. Bastian/Business Executive, Bradley/Elected Official-Salt Lake County, Sharp M.D./Cardiologist, Local 222/Labor Union, R&R Advertising/Advertising Agency, Imai/Imai Keller) and are not emitted. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: on p6 and p7 the right-hand block (Date/Amount/Occupation/Employer) sits 14-17 px LOWER on the page than the left-hand block (In Kind/Last/First) because of scan skew; row i still pairs with row i (verified by matching header offsets, uniform 26.7 px pitch, the in-kind cross-gate above, and the semantic checks named). No shifted row was found on any page. Schedule B prints two identical 8/10/2008 Stringham Lumber $305.02 rows (one marked In Kind, one not); both are retained because the printed TOTAL gates exactly only with both. Schedule A's matching Stringham in-kind row is a single $305.
